summary.text: Steve Duffy is a Republican state representative from District 32 who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a business owner and former television advertising executive.

paragraphs.text: Steve Duffy was born in Fort Pierre, South Dakota.
His career experience includes owning a business and working as a television advertising executive and sales manager.
Duffy assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 10, 2023, and serves on the House Commerce and Energy Committee and the House Transportation Committee.
